ABOUT COLDLINE

A focused AI product.
A clearly defined buyer.

For fresh-produce exporters, cold stores and logistics operators. Coldline checks pallet images and changing temperature records, then explains which shipment needs a cold-chain intervention.

Illustrative operating context · licensed photography
THE BUSINESS IDEA

AI reviews produce images and temperature histories to flag shipments at risk.

A shipment’s condition can change between collection and delivery. Images, door events and temperature histories must be reviewed repeatedly across many active loads.

Who buys it
Produce exporters & cold-chain operators
What they send in
Pallet images and shipment temperature histories
What they receive
A condition warning with the affected pallet and reason
How it is sold
A B2B subscription with a defined processing allowance.
OWNERSHIP & PRODUCT STATUS

Clear about the
business behind the page.

Coldline is an MVP product concept developed for Uniqkode. The website and review tools work; prepared case data demonstrates the intended AI workflow. A live model account and production identity service are not connected by default.

Customer endorsements, paid-user counts and company registration details have not been supplied. This website makes no claim that an unrelated company uses the product or that a registered legal entity operates it.
